reader.requirement: At 85 END-STRING terminates the STRING statement's scope: a STRING with END-STRING is a delimited scope (imperative) statement that may nest in another statement's imperative-statement, each END-STRING closes the most recent unterminated STRING, optional conditional phrases associate with the nearest unterminated statement that may take them (§1985:IV.6.4.3), and a conditional STRING without END-STRING inside an imperative-statement is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: format filter by ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable; STRING's row has no construct, so the 85 arm is the 2023 arm

reader.edition-search: ProcedureFormatPass.VisitStatementBlock and ConditionalStatements.IsConditional carry no edition test (grep Edition|Version in ProcedureFormatPass.cs: only using lines and EditionDiagnostic).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf02_04 covers END-STRING after phrases and inside IF; not exercised: nested STRING within STRING, END-STRING with no phrases, phrase association to an inner STRING, refusal of an unterminated conditional STRING in an imperative-statement

probes.expected: case 1: inner END-STRING closes the inner STRING, DISPLAY belongs to outer ON OVERFLOW; case 2 END-STRING alone legal; case 3: NOT ON OVERFLOW associates with the inner STRING (IV.6.4.3), END-STRING closes the inner, so the following DISPLAY is in the outer's ON OVERFLOW, which does not run (AB fits R2)
